english.note: Use this for adding a caption, graphic, filter, or other overlay to an image, video, map, or interface.
Use this when an extra thing is added or supplied alongside something else.

examples.english: We overlay this video with subtitles, and it is much clearer.
examples.traditional: 呢段片加上字幕之後，睇落清楚好多。
